verdict.rationale: Glama holds user data (chat conversations, uploaded documents, hosted server instances, usage logs), so a data-export story is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no export or portability feature. The OpenAPI directory API, which covers servers, connectors, instances and usage, is a developer building block for building a client, not a documented user data-export capability. Saving and tagging chats is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
